GENERAL FARE INFORMATION
REDUCED RATE INFORMATION
CHILDREN'S FARES - One child under 2 years of age not occu-
pying a seat and accompanied by an adult fare paying passenger
may be
carried free. Children between 2 and 12 years of age are
carried half fare.
EXCURSION FARE - A special same-day round trip excursion fare
via any scheduled flight is vailable for only $6.00 plus tax. Ad-
vance reservations are not permitted under this fare.
FAMILY PLAN - SFO Helicopter Airlines Family Plan is avail-
MILITARY FARES - Military personel on furlough or leave trav-
eling at their own expense in uniform and in possession of author-
ized military leave papers travel for each 50% of the full adult one
way fare. (Stand by basis only).
OUTH FARES - Students possessing any airline issued identif
ation card travel for 50% of the full adult one way fare. Exclude
dates: May 27 thru 31, June 1 thru 2, July 1 thru 7, Sept 2 thru 8,
Nov 21 thru 27, Dec 22 thru 31, Jan 1 thru 4. (Stand by basis only).
FREE AND REDUCED FARES WHEN USING FOLLOWING AIRLINES
The airlines listed below provide their passengers with
FREE or reduced rate SFO Helicopter transportation.
The table below lists fares to be paid by the pas senger
and the applicability. When purchasing air transporta-
tion on the carriers shown, be sure to ask the travel
agent or airline ticket agent to include the SFO Heli-
copter for each direction. If this is not convenient, any
SFO agent can offer these low fares with our new add-
on ticket as long as the passenger has a valid unused
domestic connecting flight coupon showing arrival or
departure at S. F. or Oakland Airport. (NOTE: when-
ever FREE helicopter transportation is offered in con-
junction with an international flight, it must be ticketed
on I.A.T.A. ticket stock.) When traveling on short no-
tice, passengers may have their fickets waiting at any
SFO station through use of standard pre-paid ticket
authorization procedures.
